description: This file defines API routes and schemas for a booking system using Flask, including endpoints for listing, creating, retrieving, and updating bookings, as well as admin functionalities.

classes.name: Brands
classes.description: API endpoint for listing supported device brands

classes.name: Models
classes.description: API endpoint for listing models for a specific brand

classes.name: Problems
classes.description: API endpoint for listing common repair problems

classes.name: Booking
classes.description: API endpoint for creating and retrieving bookings

classes.name: AdminBookings
classes.description: Admin API endpoint for listing bookings with filters

classes.name: AdminUpdateStatus
classes.description: Admin API endpoint for updating booking status

methods.name: get
methods.description: Handles GET requests for various endpoints, such as listing brands, models, problems, retrieving bookings, and admin listing with filters.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Handles POST requests for creating bookings, updating booking status, and admin booking status updates.
